specification: Add a Python 3 module greeting.py exposing greeting(name: str) -> str. Strip leading and trailing whitespace from name. For a nonempty result return "Hello, <name>!"; for an empty or whitespace-only name return "Hello, friend!". Preserve Unicode names as literal text. Add meaningful standard-library unittest tests for normal, trimmed, blank and Unicode names in tests/test_greeting.py. Add an additive README section with the exact command python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v. Preserve all existing repository files and behavior. Do not change .github/workflows, use network or filesystem side effects in the function, add dependencies, publish credentials or publish private execution history. Keep this to one small Node in the selected controlled Project.
